name: @w6w-apps/neverbounce
description: Verify email addresses one at a time or in bulk jobs, and check credit balance, via the NeverBounce v4.2 API.

w6w.longDescription:
NeverBounce verifies email addresses — checking a single address synchronously, or running a bulk job against thousands of rows supplied directly or fetched from a remote CSV URL. A single-check result reports one of valid, invalid, disposable, catchall, or unknown, plus diagnostic flags (DNS/MX presence, SMTP connectability, role-account and free-email detection) and an optional address breakdown.

Bulk verification is a four-step lifecycle this app exposes as separate actions so a workflow can pause between them (or react to a callback instead of polling): create a job, parse it, start it, then poll its status or read paginated per-row results — or download the whole thing as a CSV. Jobs and their results can also be searched and deleted.

Beyond verification, this app covers account visibility: a credit-balance and job-count read, surfaced both as a standalone action and as this app's quota health check.

A fit for gating a signup flow on a real-looking address, cleaning a list before a bulk send, or scoring an existing list's quality before importing it into a CRM or ESP.

NeverBounce's client-side JS verification widget and its `/poe/confirm` server-side confirmation endpoint are deliberately out of scope — see the README.
